key.name: hot-corners
key.summary: Hot corners that open the depth view
key.description: Corners of the primary monitor that open the depth view when the pointer enters them. Known values are 'top-left', 'top-right', 'bottom-left' and 'bottom-right'; unknown values are ignored. An empty list means no corner opens the depth view.

key.name: show-top-bar-indicator
key.description: Whether zatto's icon is shown in the top bar. Its menu opens the depth view and the preferences.

key.name: license-status
key.description: The license gate's status: 'trial', 'trial-expired', 'valid', 'expired' or 'invalid'. Managed by zatto.

key.name: license-key
key.description: The activated license key. Set from the preferences window.

key.name: license-activation-id
key.description: Activation id the license API returned when the license key was activated. Managed by zatto.

key.name: license-valid-until
key.description: End of the subscription period as last confirmed by the license API, in Unix seconds. Managed by zatto.

key.name: license-last-validated
key.description: Time of the last successful validation against the license API, in Unix seconds. Managed by zatto.

key.name: last-online-at
key.description: Last time the device was online, in Unix seconds; 0 means not recorded. A valid license keeps working offline for 7 days from it. Managed by zatto.

key.name: trial-days-used
key.description: Days of use counted during the trial (0 to 30). A day counts once, the first time the depth view is opened that day. Managed by zatto.

key.name: trial-last-used-date
key.description: The last day counted as a day of use during the trial, as YYYY-MM-DD. Managed by zatto.

key.name: trial-warning-last-threshold
key.description: Remaining-day threshold (3 or 1) of the last warning that the trial is about to end; 0 means none yet. Managed by zatto.

key.name: trial-probe-result
key.description: Whether the license API answered the check made after the trial ended: 'none', 'answered' or 'no-response'. Managed by zatto.
